description: This file contains a factory function to create instances of different storage backend classes based on a specified backend type. It defines how to instantiate backends like AzureBlobStorageBackend and raises exceptions for unsupported types. The file also imports dependencies and provides logging for debugging.

methods.name: BaseFileStorageBackend get_storage_backend(backend_type: str)
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a storage backend instance based on the provided backend_type string. It configures the backend and raises an error if the type is unsupported.
